parts.style: calm, reverent, reading scripture aloud slowly
parts.text: The Lord thy God in the midst of thee is mighty; <short pause> he will save, he will rejoice over thee with joy; <short pause> he will rest in his love, he will joy over thee with singing. <short pause> Zephaniah, chapter three, verse seventeen.

Mighty God, You are here with me, closer than my own breath. <short pause> You delight in me and quiet me with Your love. <short pause> The thought that You rejoice over me with singing fills my heart with wonder. <short pause> I rest in Your joyful presence tonight. <short pause> Amen.
